patronOf.en-US: The beginning of St. John's Gospel closes the Mass
patronOf.pt-BR: O início do Evangelho de São João encerra a Missa

prayerExcerpt.en-US: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: No princípio era o Verbo, e o Verbo estava com Deus, e o Verbo era Deus.

meta.basis: After the blessing the priest goes to the gospel corner, signs the altar or the book and himself, and 'junctis manibus legit Evangelium: In principio'; at Et Verbum caro factum est he genuflects, and the server 'stans a parte Epistolae' answers Deo gratias (Ritus servandus XII.1). The Last Gospel stands on the gospel-side altar card (Fortescue, l. 2988–2989); all stand for it (l. 6697). The card shows the reading, not the genuflection, which would repeat the Profession of Faith card.
